messages:
Maya T: Quick sync — woke up to rapid churn on a few dedicated pools this morning. Not the usual headroom flip.
Noah V: Any obvious telemetry lag or is the allocator misbehaving?
Maya T: Telemetry looked sane. The allocator emitted late lease-expiry events and the operator treated nodes as free, which the autoscaler then reclaimed.
Omar H: Classic operator-intent vs telemetry race. We need a teardown authority and a way to resolve contested signals.
Priya R: Proposal: require dual-confirmation for scale-downs: operator intent + telemetry confirmation across multiple windows. If they disagree mark the node contested and delay teardown.
Quinn S: Alternative / complementary: controlplane issues short-lived lease-extension tokens that runtime can honor to prevent immediate evictions during transient conditions.
Noah V: Tokens make sense but must be nonce'd and auditable. Operator must check token presence before progressing teardown.
Ruth Z: Also: add telemetry_epoch and ingest_ts to metrics. Controlplane should drop or de-prioritize samples older than epoch-1 to avoid late replays flipping decisions.
Maya T: Sketch config (rough):
``npolicy:
  teardown_authority: dual_confirm
  telemetry_windows: [8s,16s,32s]
  contested_hold: 45s
  lease_extension_ttl: 20s
  max_down_rate: 1/60s
```
Priya R: Add per-tenant policy overrides: latency-sensitive SKUs get longer contested_hold and higher min_replicas.
Omar H: Fastpath for scale-up: if free_capacity < critical_threshold and burst_credits > 0 -> immediate upscales, but tag the action and throttle credit spend (e.g., 2 credits/min).
Quinn S: Observability: emit teardown_cause (operator|telemetry|contested) and confirming_windows for every scale action. Surface contested_count in dashboards/alerts.
quota-bot: quota check: pool dedicated-us-east-1 burst_credits=120 -> allowed to spend up to configured throttle.
Maya T: Rollout plan: implement decision-boundary in controlplane; add lease-token v1 in runtime; stage with synthetic lease jitter and delayed telemetry tests.
Noah V: I'll draft the token RFC and own the test harness. Omar/Priya can review the policy semantics.
Ruth Z: I'll prepare dashboard panels and set an alert when contested_count > 5 in 10m or churn_rate exceeds threshold.
Maya T: Filing follow-up ticket infra#1502 and scheduling a 2hr test window next Tue. Thanks all — closing thread. :thumbsup:
